source: r810 a concept board 1376x768 (4 screens x 331 px, content y 8-692); 1 atlas px = 1 native px = 1.178 css at the s15 scale (screen = 390 css wide)

zhugeliang.whirlpool.draw: ink whirlpool ellipse (frame 2): centre on the CENTRE enemy tile, rim just outside the 3x3 board (~ board width), lies flat; spin it (rotate about its centre) 650 ms; never below the gap line

zhugeliang.rings.draw: three violet sound rings (frame 1): centre on the gate foot (top-centre of the enemy board), expand + fade over 600 ms, draw lighter; ellipses ~ 2.4:1

zhugeliang.strings.draw: seven violet-white string lines lashed across the enemy board (frame 2), one piece, 331 px wide; draw across the board centre, vibrate (shift y +-3 css) then SNAP out at the frame 3 start; draw lighter

zhugeliang.wall.draw: ink-wash city wall + open gate + sky, OPAQUE band 331x146 px (390x172 css) pinned to the TOP of the enemy board area (y of the board far edge); Zhuge Liang at the zither is baked in (calm pose); plaque painted blank; frames 1 and 3

zhugeliang.wall_glow.draw: frame 2 swap for zhugeliang.wall: same size and place, violet glow, strike pose (fan raised) baked in; crossfade 150 ms

zhugeliang.wall_pale.draw: frame 4: pale ink outline wall, gate CLOSED, no figure, no plaque; same size and place; crossfade from wall over 400 ms

zhugeliang.crowns9.draw: ALL NINE ink crowns of frame 3 as one 3x3 set (331 px wide): they overlap, so this is the safe piece; place it over the enemy board exactly like the painting (centre on the centre tile); soldiers have holes where they stood (draw the squads over it, or draw the squads at 70% so ink shows through)

zhugeliang.crown.draw: one ink crown (top-middle of frame 3): bottom-centre on a squad, grows 0 -> full height in 180 ms; its sides are trimmed where the neighbours touched, so for a clean 9 use crowns9 and treat this as a spare/test; mirror left-right freely

zhugeliang.stain.draw: spiral ink stain decal (frame 4): one under each enemy squad (9), centre on the squad centre, ~0.9 tile wide (~110 css); fades in 300 ms after the crowns; rotate 0/90/180/270 per squad so they differ; the squad hides the middle; flat grey ink colour, alpha carries the strokes

zhugeliang.swirl.draw: violet dizzy swirl (frames 3-4): tiny native piece (about 14 css); spin it, 1-2 above each squad head; if too soft, draw a code spiral in the same violet instead

zhugeliang.figure_play.draw: Zhuge Liang at the zither in the tower window, feathered 104x68 patch: lay it on zhugeliang.wall at the same offset only if you swap the pose; baked into wall already

zhugeliang.figure_strike.draw: strike pose, fan raised, violet glow: baked into wall_glow already; patch given for a separate pop at 250-400 ms
